newsitem.title: USA: Boston Ed says 5-7 day shutdown at Pilgrim.
newsitem.headline: Boston Ed says 5-7 day shutdown at Pilgrim.

text.p: Boston Edison Co said Wednesday it is putting its 670 megawatt (MW) Pilgrim nuclear power station into cold shutdown for five to seven days to correct problems with a set of the plant's heat exchangers.
The Nuclear Regulatory Commission earlier Wednesday reported the unit was in startup mode after an outage Tuesday.
The report, showing Pilgrim output at two percent of capacity, was filed with the NRC as the unit was decreasing production, company spokesman Dave Tarantino said.
"We took the plant off line due to saltwater intrusion in the heat exchangers in the reactor building," he said.
